hook: Zoom through 43 powers of ten, from a proton to the observable universe, past 38 real things drawn to scale. Then compare any two, place things on a power-of-ten line and slide the decimal point.
outcome: Read and write very large and very small numbers in scientific notation, compare quantities by how many times larger one is than another, and estimate sizes as a single digit times a power of ten
sources: Sizes: typical published values (NASA, NIST, encyclopedias), rounded; living things vary and the Oort cloud is an estimate
Illustrations drawn with FLUX.1-schnell (Apache 2.0) on a local computer, edited for Curio Class
